statement: For every prescribed binary depth there are positive alpha,beta with irrational ratio whose displayed base-2 floor terms have no two consecutive subset sums. Conversely, if a disjoint prefix supplies height-marked representatives q h_r+r for every residue and a disjoint tail supplies q times a quotient interval at least max(h_r)-min(h_r) long, their union contains an explicit consecutive integer interval.
closes: the exact sufficient interface from modular representatives to an integer interval
dependency_gaps: No theorem forces arbitrarily long disjoint q-multiple quotient cores along every irrational-ratio carry path.
Sparse carry blocks defeat every tested single-modulus single-split strategy by exponential finite margins.
The gamma in (1,2) variant still lacks the integral binary recurrence.
